leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the shape of dashboard data
Initialize and manage component state with typed React hooks
Implement reusable functional components with typed props
Configure event handlers to manipulate dashboard state
Integrate multiple components to build a complete dashboard layout
Render dynamic content by mapping over typed data arrays
Apply TypeScript generics to create flexible utility functions
lessonTitle: Build end to end capstone React plus TS enterprise dashboard
